findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: GetTerritoryWealthProfile, SearchFundsByCategory · Private data: SearchBrokerCheck, SearchBrokerCheckFirm, GetBrokerCheckDetail, SearchIAPDFirm, GetIAPDFirmDetail, SearchEdgar13F, GetEdgarCompanyFilings, GetTerritoryWealthProfile, GetTickerInfo, GetPriceHistory, GetMultiTickerHistory, GetOptionsExpirations, GetOptionsChain, GetFinancials, GetEarningsHistory, GetAnalystRatings, GetHolders, GetDividendsAndSplits, GetFundProfile, LookupTicker, SearchFundsByCategory, GetFundFees, Get13FHoldings, SearchIAPDIndividual, GetIAPDIndividualDetail, SearchFredSeries, GetFredSeriesData, MapInstrumentIds, SearchFigiInstruments, SearchLEI, GetLEIDetail, GetAdvisorBenchmarks · Public sink: GetTerritoryWealthProfile, GetEarningsHistory, GetFundFees, Get13FHoldings · Destructive: SearchEdgar13F, GetFundFees.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: GetTerritoryWealthProfile, SearchFundsByCategory · Private data: SearchBrokerCheck, SearchBrokerCheckFirm, GetBrokerCheckDetail, SearchIAPDFirm, GetIAPDFirmDetail, SearchEdgar13F, GetEdgarCompanyFilings, GetTerritoryWealthProfile, GetTickerInfo, GetPriceHistory, GetMultiTickerHistory, GetOptionsExpirations, GetOptionsChain, GetFinancials, GetEarningsHistory, GetAnalystRatings, GetHolders, GetDividendsAndSplits, GetFundProfile, LookupTicker, SearchFundsByCategory, GetFundFees, Get13FHoldings, SearchIAPDIndividual, GetIAPDIndividualDetail, SearchFredSeries, GetFredSeriesData, MapInstrumentIds, SearchFigiInstruments, SearchLEI, GetLEIDetail, GetAdvisorBenchmarks · Public sink: GetTerritoryWealthProfile, GetEarningsHistory, GetFundFees, Get13FHoldings · Destructive: SearchEdgar13F, GetFundFees

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
